summary: Godmode pre-launch auth verification. Tested /login (password + magic-link tabs), wrong password, valid login with accelerator@wladbot.test, session persistence on refresh, /login redirect for authed user, magic-link enumeration safety, registration flow, and /simulations page load. 6 of 8 checks PASS. Two auth issues found (1 P0, 1 P1) that must be fixed before 1000-client onboarding.

minor.issue: Wrong-password response returns English literal 'Invalid credentials' as detail. UI has no German mapping for this, so the user sees English text on a German page. Either backend should return a translatable code (e.g. 'invalid_credentials') or frontend parseAuthError must map it to a German string.

ui_bugs.issue: P0: When an already-logged-in user navigates to /login (or /signup /register), they are NOT redirected to /dashboard. Page stays on /login and shows the login form. Missing useEffect that checks auth state and calls navigate(postLoginRoute(user)). This is a Godmode blocker for the launch.

P1: Wrong-password error text shown to the user is 'Invalid credentials' (English) although app language is German. parseAuthError does not translate the backend detail. Requirement: 'clear German error toast/message'.

integration_issues.issue: AuthContext relies on httpOnly cookie only - localStorage.getItem('wladbot_token') returns null after a successful login. Review request assumed 'session persists via localStorage token'. Persistence via refresh DOES work through the cookie. Please confirm cookie-only is intended; if yes, update /app/memory/test_credentials.md.

issues: Cookie-consent banner (data-testid=cookie-consent-banner, z-[9999]) intercepts pointer events on content behind it in some viewports - blocked ArgumentationPrepModal opener during automated test. Consider auto-hiding pointer-events on non-interactive wrapper or lowering banner z-index once the user is inside the app after login.

action_items: P0: In LoginPage (and register/signup route), add useEffect that redirects to postLoginRoute(user) as soon as auth context resolves an authenticated user. Currently the /login route is reachable while logged in.
P1: Translate 'Invalid credentials' -> German ('E-Mail oder Passwort ist falsch.') either in backend response mapping or in frontend parseAuthError.
Clarify session storage strategy: cookie-only vs localStorage. Update docs or restore localStorage token write in AuthContext.login().
Consider ensuring cookie banner does not block critical UI elements after acceptance.
critical_code_review_comments: LoginPage.js has no redirect-if-authenticated guard - this is the root cause of the P0 bug.
authErrors.parseAuthError likely returns backend detail verbatim; should map known English tokens ('Invalid credentials', 'User not found', etc.) to localized strings.
AuthContext appears to not persist an accessible token - cookie-only is fine but requires that all API calls use withCredentials=true and never fall back to a Bearer token from localStorage.
test_credentials: accelerator@wladbot.test / test123 (used, works). Free tier: free@wladbot.test / test123.
seed_data_creation: Created one throwaway registration account with email test_launch_<timestamp>@wladbot.test (goes to /onboarding). No cleanup performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes the P0 redirect and P1 German error, re-run: (1) log in accelerator@wladbot.test/test123 lands on /dashboard, (2) then manually visit /login and verify auto-redirect to /dashboard, (3) wrong password shows a German auth-error. ArgumentationPrepModal test failed only because of cookie-banner overlay; accept the cookie banner before interacting. All other auth flows (valid login, session persistence via refresh, magic-link enumeration-safe response, registration -> onboarding) already PASS.
rca of the issue: P0 root cause: LoginPage.js (lines 35-145) never checks the AuthContext user state and never calls navigate on mount if already authed. Navigation only happens inside handleSubmit and handleOAuthSuccess. Fix: add `const { user } = useAuth(); useEffect(() => { if (user) navigate(postLoginRoute(user), { replace: true }); }, [user]);` near the top of the component. P1 root cause: backend /api/auth/login returns `{detail:'Invalid credentials'}` in English; frontend lib/authErrors parseAuthError falls through to returning detail verbatim without a German mapping.
